keyword: how did sinatra's son die in paradise
claims: In Paradise, Sinatra’s young son, Dylan, died from an unspecified "mystery" illness in childhood.
Dylan collapsed at a grocery store.
Dylan passed away after receiving more than a year of medical treatment.
According to the Villains Wiki, a sudden collapse followed by a terminal unknown illness was the cause of Dylan's death.
According to the Villains Wiki, Dylan's death motivated Sinatra's later efforts to create a utopia in his memory.
According to Decider, Sinatra sought counseling from Dr. Gabriela Torabi.
According to Paste Magazine, in Season 2 it is heavily implied through time-travel elements that Link is an adult version of Sinatra's son Dylan, who died as a child.
